sentences.text:
Shri R.S. Patel - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Amit Pandey - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.

Order 
This is first application on behalf of the applicant under Section 482 of the BNSS, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No.69/2025 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Narsinghpur for the offence punishable under Sections 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that from the allegations made against the present applicant and the case of the prosecution, prima- facie it appears that the dispute is of civil nature.

The dispute is with regard to the land and getting the name recorded by virtue of a forged document,
although counsel submits that it is not proved whether any fraudulent act has been committed by the applicant.

He submits that the offence under Section 420 of IPC has been registered against the applicant for which maximum punishment for seven years is provided and as such arrest of the applicant is not required.
He submits that the applicant shall provide full cooperation to the investigating agency in the investigation.

Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that applicant has past criminal antecedent as offences under the Gambling Act and also under Section 324 of IPC has been registered against him.

Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
Kamlesh Kumar Soni vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95764574/
1 2025:MPHC-JBP:6098 2 MCRC-5746-2025 parties and after perusal of case diary, I am inclined to consider and allow this application.

entities.text:
NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
Kamlesh Kumar Soni vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Accordingly, without commenting anything on merit of the case,
this application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with a surety bond of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer/Station House Officer of the police station concerned.

The benefit of anticipatory bail is granted to the applicant subject to condition that if any assistance of the applicant is required, the Investigating Officer can call him and he shall provide full assistance to the Investigating Officer.
It is also directed that if arrest of the applicant is required, the Investigating Officer may do so after issuing notice to the applicant.
It is further directed that applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 482(2) of BNSS, 2023.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE RAGHVENDRA Kamlesh Kumar Soni vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95764574/
